dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Setting up Dogecoin full nodes on the Moon and/or satellites would allow for quick relay of transactions between Earth and Mars. Full nodes can run on small form factor, low-power equipment like a Raspberry connected to a solar-powered battery, and could be deployed with Starlink

@dogecoin_devs Is there an official docker image to quickly spin up new full nodes? If not, I would like to make one (I could just create mine and post in on the reddit but using a docker image form an unverified dev is highly risky and no one would use it)
